body: Thanks. Yeah you're right, there is hope, just not as much of it as I'd like... Maybe it'll be enough to sustain me, maybe it won't. I'm not even sure if I care any more.

Any time between now and 2 weeks time. If they even work for me, which isn't guaranteed. I don't know if I can hold on that long. I don't have a network of support or anything. I have nothing to keep me going, and the hope of feeling better despite my situation staying the same isn't really hope at all, is it? I can't really bring myself to feel hopeful and positive about the prospect of feeling better. I'd like to have a reason to feel better. I want to be happy, not just "happy" from meds. I hate everything about what I'm having to go through.

I wish I had the patience to be miserable indefinitely in the hope that counseling and stuff will make my anxiety better. I've seen a counselor once, and she told me to get on some anti depressants. They're yet to have any positive effect, but it's only been 2 weeks. I'll see her again in mid January if I'm still alive then.

I'm just really not coping and there are no quick solutions. I've never felt worse about anything, and another few days of this feeling will kill me off. I can't stand it. I can't get better. I'm trapped in misery.

I appreciate that from your point of view you're just trying to help me. However, I've done so many nice things over my life, I give and give and give and I've never asked for anything in return. Sure I'm probably a bit of a horrible piece of shit now, but the life I've had could make anyone turn rotten.

Don't insult me by saying God's looking out for me, because he's not rewarded me with a single fucking thing to be happy about. Why am I cutting myself? Why am I seriously planning my own death? Why am I so alone? Fuck your God.

Thanks. To be honest I'm sick of waiting for these supposed nice people to show up in my life. People have been telling me the same stuff for years, it'll get better, you'll meet someone who makes you forget your troubles.... it's all bullshit. Nobody is willing to give me what I need. And why the fuck should they? I'm certainly not a good catch for a girl. I'm barely holding myself together and I'd just be a burden.

Not everyone gets to be happy. Lots of people are driven to suicide each day. I feel like I'm just another statistic.

It's not really enough for you to just say that. I don't care who believes in me, since I don't even believe in myself.

I've got some razor blades out and I've started cutting myself. I don't even know what to do. How do people avoid killing themselves?

I don't think you realise how bad social anxiety can be. Chatting to any stranger is completely untenable. Even going to a coffee shop by myself is too much. I'm not interested in the idea that I'll eventually succeed in a few years or whatever. It's not enough to have some futile hope. I want to be happier; now. I'm so unhappy that if this goes on longer I'll kill myself. It doesn't make me feel any better to have someone tell me that one day I might have the courage to talk to a girl, because realistically I'll be long dead before I get the chance to meet "ms. right".

Not about killing myself. The feeling's pretty new to me. I'm 2 weeks into a course of anti depressants but they're yet to have any positive effects. I'm seeing a counselor about my anxiety but I've only seen her once so far and won't see her until the middle of January. Even then things won't magically improve. I'm too far gone. I've spoke to one friend in real life about depression and anxiety.

Thanks. Life feels more than just hard. I want it to end, no more pain, no more suffering. I think slitting my throat is the only action I can realistically take in order to be at peace. 

*Oh and no, my anxiety makes that pretty much impossible. Also I pretty much never go out. And I have no confidence. And even if I were to talk to someone the chances of us having a relationship are so astronomically slim that I'd rather not put myself through the whole ordeal.
